entries.title: Job 37:1
segments: ¶At this also my heart trembleth, and is moved out of his place.

entries.title: Job 37:2
segments: Hear attentively the noise of his voice, and the sound [that] goeth out of his mouth. {Hear...: Heb. Hear in hearing}

entries.title: Job 37:3
segments: He directeth it under the whole heaven, and his lightning unto the ends of the earth. {lightning: Heb. light} {ends: Heb. wings}

entries.title: Job 37:4
segments: After it a voice roareth: he thundereth with the voice of his excellency; and he will not stay them when his voice is heard.

entries.title: Job 37:5
segments: God thundereth marvellously with his voice; great things doeth he, which we cannot comprehend.

entries.title: Job 37:6
segments: ¶For he saith to the snow, Be thou [on] the earth; likewise to the small rain, and to the great rain of his strength. {likewise...: Heb. and to the shower of rain, and to the showers of rain of his strength}

words.text: . {likewise...: Heb. and to the shower of rain, and to the showers of rain of his strength}

entries.title: Job 37:7
segments: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.

entries.title: Job 37:8
segments: Then the beasts go into dens, and remain in their places.

entries.title: Job 37:9
segments: Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north. {south: Heb. chamber} {north: Heb. scattering winds}

entries.title: Job 37:10
segments: By the breath of God frost is given: and the breadth of the waters is straitened.

entries.title: Job 37:11
segments: Also by watering he wearieth the thick cloud: he scattereth his bright cloud: {his...: Heb. the cloud of his light}

words.text: : {his...: Heb. the cloud of his light}

entries.title: Job 37:12
segments: And it is turned round about by his counsels: that they may do whatsoever he commandeth them upon the face of the world in the earth.

entries.title: Job 37:13
segments: He causeth it to come, whether for correction, or for his land, or for mercy. {correction: Heb. a rod}

entries.title: Job 37:14
segments: ¶Hearken unto this, O Job: stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

entries.title: Job 37:15
segments: Dost thou know when God disposed them, and caused the light of his cloud to shine?

entries.title: Job 37:16
segments: Dost thou know the balancings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him which is perfect in knowledge?

entries.title: Job 37:17
segments: How thy garments [are] warm, when he quieteth the earth by the south [wind]?

entries.title: Job 37:18
segments: Hast thou with him spread out the sky, [which is] strong, [and] as a molten looking glass?

words.text: Hast thou with him spread out

entries.title: Job 37:19
segments: Teach us what we shall say unto him; [for] we cannot order [our speech] by reason of darkness.

entries.title: Job 37:20
segments: Shall it be told him that I speak? if a man speak, surely he shall be swallowed up.

words.text: , surely he shall be swallowed up

entries.title: Job 37:21
segments: ¶And now [men] see not the bright light which [is] in the clouds: but the wind passeth, and cleanseth them.

entries.title: Job 37:22
segments: Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God [is] terrible majesty. {Fair...: Heb. Gold}

entries.title: Job 37:23
segments: [Touching] the Almighty, we cannot find him out: [he is] excellent in power, and in judgment, and in plenty of justice: he will not afflict.

entries.title: Job 37:24
segments: Men do therefore fear him: he respecteth not any [that are] wise of heart.
